cards.text: God made David, Israel's king, a promise through Nathan the prophet: "And I will subdue all your enemies." (1 Chronicles 17:10) Now it's some time later, and David heads out to war. Friend, tie that apron tight, because this chapter moves FAST.

cards.question: Some time after God's promise, David goes to war. Which people does David defeat and subdue?

cards.text: David even takes Gath and its villages right out of the Philistines' hand. Gath is Goliath's hometown (1 Samuel 17:4), so the shepherd with the sling who beat Goliath (1 Samuel 17:50) just took over the man's whole ZIP CODE.

cards.question: David also defeats the Moabites. What happens to Moab after that?

answers.text: They serve David and bring tribute
They flee and leave their land
They join David as equal partners

cards.text: Then the big one: Hadadezer, king of Zobah, marching out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River. David defeats him as far as Hamath.

cards.question: David captures a thousand chariots from King Hadadezer, plus thousands of his soldiers. True or false: David keeps every one of the chariot horses.

cards.text: David keeps just a hundred horses for the chariots. All the rest, he hamstrings.
Then the Arameans of Damascus come to help Hadadezer, and David strikes down twenty-two thousand of their men.

cards.question: David has just struck down the Arameans who came to help King Hadadezer. What does David place in Aram of Damascus?

answers.text: A king to rule for him

cards.question: The Arameans become subject to David and bring him tribute, just like the Moabites. Then the chapter tells us who is behind all these wins: So the ___ made David victorious wherever he went.

cards.text: David takes the gold shields that belonged to Hadadezer's officers and brings them to Jerusalem. That's like winning the company softball game and walking out with the OTHER team's trophies too.

cards.question: From Tibhath and Cun, cities of King Hadadezer, David takes a large amount of bronze. Which of David's sons (1 Chronicles 3:1-5) later uses that bronze to make the bronze Sea and the pillars?
When King Tou of Hamath hears that David defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sends his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for it. True or false: Tou had been at war with Hadadezer himself.

cards.text: Hadoram brings all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze. Friend, that's not a thank-you card, that's a thank-you WAREHOUSE.

cards.question: King David now has Hadoram's gold, silver and bronze, plus the silver and gold he carried off from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines and the Amalekites. What does David do with all of it?

answers.text: Pays the men in his army

cards.text: And there's more. Abishai, son of David's sister Zeruiah (1 Chronicles 2:16), strikes down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

cards.question: After the battle in the Valley of Salt, true or false: only some of the Edomites become subject to David.
That line again: the LORD made David victorious wherever he went. Now David administers justice and righteousness for all his people. True or false: David reigns over all Israel.

cards.text: David's got a whole crew, from Joab son of Zeruiah over the army to Zadok and Ahimelech as priests, with David's sons as chief officials at the king's side. My crew is me, my mustache and one very patient oven.
